data.title: Why Is Ethereum Up Today? ETH Hits Highest Price Since January as $2,757 Comes Into View
data.description: Ethereum is up again today (Saturday), extending Friday's rally to its highest price since January. Ether traded at $2,646 on Bitstamp at 17:56 UTC, up 1.3% on the day and about 8% above Thursday's close, after touching $2,668 earlier in the session.The move takes ETH above $2,616, the ceiling that…
